history.summary: Thinly sourced record. ETV Telugu's Teerthayatra programme aired an episode on 'Sri Venkateswara Temple, Suryapet' (9 Aug 2025), confirming a notable local Vaishnava shrine in Suryapet town, and Justdial lists a Venkateswara Temple at Madhavaram, Suryapet. No reliable published history, founding date, architecture, festival or timing details were found online. Coordinates are Suryapet town centre - exact temple location unverified. CSV 'state' column held the town name; actual state is Telangana.

name: Sri Venkateswara Temple
town_description: Suryapet is a town and district headquarters in eastern Telangana, about 140 km from Hyderabad on the Hyderabad-Vijayawada highway (NH65). It is a regional commercial hub and the district's main urban centre, with the Musi river flowing nearby.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (~140 km; verify)
travel.road: NH65 (Hyderabad-Vijayawada); local transport in Suryapet town
